配置在别处被修改过，将重新读取最新值。: Configuration was modified elsewhere. Reloading the latest values.
其它页面不受影响。可以原地重试，或先返回会话列表。: Other screens are unaffected. You can retry here, or go back to the session list first.
清除后本机保存的设备凭证会被删除，再连接需要在服务器上重新运行 dsh-pair: Clearing deletes the device credentials saved on this device. To reconnect, run dsh-pair on the server again to generate a new pairing code (the old code cannot be reused).
请在系统设置里允许 DSH 使用相机。: Allow DSH to use the camera in system settings.
任务可能已被修改或结束: The task may have been modified or ended
扫码或粘贴配对串: Scan a QR code or paste a pairing string
扫码配对要用摄像头读取终端里的二维码。不给权限也可以退回手动粘贴。: Scanning to pair uses the camera to read the QR code in the terminal. You can fall back to manual pasting without granting permission.
删除后这条任务的投递记录也会移除（已入队的消息不会撤回）。确定？: Deleting also removes this task's delivery records (messages already queued won't be recalled). Are you sure?
上滑或下滑切换会话；读屏用户可上/下调一档: Swipe up or down to switch sessions; screen reader users can move one step up or down.
设备授权已被撤销，请重新配对: Device authorization was revoked. Please pair again.
设备已离线，等待网络恢复: Device offline, waiting for the network to recover
审计记录只留工具名和说明文字，参数在对应的工具行上。: Audit records keep only the tool name and description. Arguments are on the corresponding tool row.
审批记录来自网关的审计事件（approval/asked + approval/: Approval records come from the gateway's audit events (approval/asked + approval/decided): the one you just decided on first appears as a local echo, then the audit record takes over once history is loaded.
审批提交被拒绝，请重试: Approval submission was rejected. Please retry.
收起这一行的完整内容: Collapse the full content of this row
输出过长，网关从中间省略了一段（保留首尾各 8000 字）: Output too long; the gateway omitted a section from the middle (keeping the first and last 8000 characters).
双击新建会话 · 语音未启用: Double-tap to start a new session · Voice off
太短啦，按住多说一会儿: Too short — hold and speak a bit longer.
跳到第一个等待审批或回答的会话: Jump to the first session waiting for approval or an answer
跳过会让 agent 收到「用户取消」，这一轮不会记录任何答案。: Skipping sends "User cancelled" to the agent; no answer will be recorded for this turn.
听到「{0}」，请在审批卡上确认: Heard "{0}", please confirm on the approval card
听到「{0}」，这个会话在等你处理: Heard "{0}", this session is waiting for you
同时上传的文件太多，等一个传完再试: Too many uploads at once. Wait for one to finish and try again.
同时下载的文件太多，稍后再试: Too many downloads at once. Try again later.
同一台设备可以记住多台网关，切换时会重新拉取会话列表: One device can remember multiple gateways; switching re-fetches the session list.
网关拒绝或未能完成连接：配对码可能已失效，也可能是代理拦截了 WebSocket: The gateway refused or could not complete the connection: the pairing code may have expired, or a proxy may be intercepting WebSocket. Disable the proxy and try again; if it still fails, regenerate the pairing code on the server.
网关没开文件上传: Gateway has not enabled file upload
网关没有可用的语音服务: Gateway has no available speech service
网关身份已变化，重新扫码后可恢复自动找回: Gateway identity changed; re-scan to restore automatic discovery.
网关协议 v{0} 未验证；App 验证的是 v{1}。: Gateway protocol v{0} is unverified; the App validates v{1}.
网关要求重新鉴权，请重新配对：在服务器上重新生成配对码: Gateway requires re-authentication. Please pair again: regenerate the pairing code on the server.
网关已关闭，请先在服务器上启用移动网关: Gateway has been shut down. Enable the mobile gateway on the server first.
网关语音忙不过来，等一下再试: Gateway speech service is busy; try again in a moment.
网关重新启用了鉴权，请重新配对: Gateway re-enabled authentication; please pair again.
未确认 · 可能没送达: Unconfirmed · may not have been delivered
文件不在会话工作目录内: File is outside the session working directory
文件超过下载上限: File exceeds the download size limit
文件内容和声明的大小不一致: File content does not match the declared size
文件校验失败，请重试: File verification failed. Please try again.
文件需要在线发送，等连接恢复后再试: Files must be sent online; try again after the connection is restored.
文件在下载前被修改了，请重试: The file was modified before download. Please try again.
我了解并接受版本不兼容的风险: I understand and accept the risk of version incompatibility
系统里没有能打开这个文件的应用: No app on this system can open this file
